title: The Plate-Cleaver's Treatise
summary: Teaches how a full-meridian cultivator drives qi into the belly to split helms and plate with chops.

title: Canon of the Field-Fed Chop
summary: Shows how a living qi field around the body feeds a kukri through long runs of chopping.

title: Advanced Studies in Notch Counters
summary: Develops the notch catch into counters that trap strong blades and return the force as a cut.

title: Treatise on the Arc of the Heavy Curve
summary: Studies the wide arcs of the curved blade and how a qi field bends each swing around guards.

title: The Twin-Hand Kukri Book of the Azure Basin
summary: Teaches a pair of kukri worked together with matched cuts and paired qi lines to students of the basin schools.

title: Hawk-Stoop Chopping Canon
summary: Trains diving chops after the manner of a hawk dropping on prey from a high guard.

title: River-Bend Studies of the Curved Blade
summary: Uses the flowing turns of a river as a model for cuts that follow the curve of the blade.

title: The Plateau Hewing Oath-Book
summary: Binds the student to a plain hewing style taught on the open plateau where no cover stands.

title: Bearing-Taken Cuts of the Gale Plateau
summary: Teaches cuts aimed by a bearing fixed on the wind and held through every turn of the fight.

title: Treatise of the Open-Wind Draw
summary: Shows the wind-sworn draw that leaves the sheath on the breath of the wind and cuts at once.
